headline: Linn of Mercy Churns as Grinding Attrition Locks Northern Fronts
war_summary: Since the last dispatch, strategic base exchanges have concentrated in Linn of Mercy and Fisherman’s Row, each registering three transitions in the past two hours. While fighting around Lathair and Rotdust sustained hundreds of casualties in Linn of Mercy, Fisherman’s Row experienced a steep drop in combat tempo following its earlier tumult, with all sector bases resting under Colonial colors. The Gutter has likewise lapsed into near total silence after its flurry of clashes at The Parras. Meanwhile, strategic base captures have temporarily paused across the broader battlefront, giving way to immense attritional punishment. Weathered Expanse continues its fierce deadlock between Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch, logging nearly two thousand casualties in the latest two hours despite no recent shifts in possession. Severe slaughter without territorial movement also batters the northern and central lines, led by Stonecradle with over twenty-seven hundred casualties in two hours, alongside sharp bloodbaths in Nevish Line, Mooring County, and Dead Lands.
